newsitem.title: THAILAND: Samart unit signs satellite deal.
newsitem.headline: Samart unit signs satellite deal.

text.p: Samart Corporation Plc said on Friday its wholly owned subsidiary Samtel Co Ltd signed a contract with the Telephone Organisation of Thailand to install 1,000 satellite communications linkage stations.
The telecommunications company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the satellite system will cover 1,475 Thai villages.
The company said it will raise part of the 1.5 billion baht (US$60 million) needed to complete the project through an initial public offering of Samtel.
Samart said construction of the stations will take 14 months. The company said the introduction of satellite communications will help develop the rural economy.
